Vlasta reports on building the trail in Říčany:

As I wrote earlier, I was approached to build the Olivova trail in my home town of Říčany. There was a very limited budget, and therefore a challenge to do something for the community. I'm an organiser and I have no problem building a natural trail, but a flow trail with jumps is outside my field. After selecting possible builders we went for Kuba Vencl, who used to ride there with local Honza Tóth, and who even got a machine operator's licence for the project. Everything important was sorted, and construction started a few weeks ago. The weather sometimes threw a spanner in the works, but the guys worked fast and the few problems along the way were solved quickly. Today is probably the last day of construction, finishing the surface. I'm attaching a few photos that I think will please every biker's eye. Our club should take over management of the area, and the Bikeskills project will have another place to train on the Tehov – Říčany route.

For next year I'm preparing two events, one of which will be the season opener and the official opening of the trail, which won't happen this year anymore. It will include a workshop, a dirt jump exhibition and a Trial exhibition.
